label: Come out of the Scottish crisis with a house left
description: The king's brother has sworn homage to England and declared himself king. Everything the house holds in Scotland is paper issued by a government that may not exist by Michaelmas.

label: Meet your son
description: Gelis sets the terms and there is no version of this that money adjusts. It is not a reconciliation; it is a beginning, conducted mostly in questions about ships.

label: Answer the question the campaign opened with
description: Whatever the dossier holds by now is what the answer will be worth. A full file compels a conclusion; a thin one is a coincidence of dates and a dead chaplain's hearsay.

label: Finish it with Jordan de Ribérac
description: Nine years of an opponent nobody could name. Whether he can be made to answer for it depends entirely on whether the Vatachino were ever unmasked.

label: Decide what the house is for
description: Scottish land, a Venetian bank, or a deliberate winding-up. The last choice the campaign asks, and the first one that closes rather than opens.

label: Settle the household
description: Tobie wants a house near a university and an argument a day. Astorre wants one more field. Julius wants to draw the last instrument himself. None of it gates the ending.

label: The rods, in a child's hands
description: Nobody teaches him. He picks them up because they are lying there.
